bug_description: A NULL-pointer dereference (SIGSEGV) occurs in upb_MiniTableEnum_CheckValue() when upb_Decode() processes wire data against a MiniTable produced by upb_MiniTable_Build() that declares a closed-enum field whose sub-enum has not been linked. The crash site is at upb/mini_table/internal/enum.h:30, where e->data[0] is dereferenced unconditionally. A 5-byte input triggers the crash deterministically.

#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR protobuf.issue-26857..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/protobuf
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi

    && git checkout FETCH_HEAD \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "protobuf at 514aceb (pre-patch)"

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/issues/26857
## Description:
Issue: protocolbuffers/protobuf#26857
Title: [Fuzzing] NULL-pointer dereference: upb_MiniTableEnum_CheckValue crash via unlinked closed-enum field in upb_Decode
State: open
Created at: 2026-04-12

Issue Body:
A NULL-pointer dereference (SIGSEGV) in upb_MiniTableEnum_CheckValue() occurs when upb_Decode() is invoked against a MiniTable produced by upb_MiniTable_Build() that declares a closed-enum field whose sub-enum has not been linked. A 5-byte input crashes the decoder deterministically. All 1,016 crash files produced during the fuzzing run deduplicate to this single root cause.

Discovered by: libFuzzer + AddressSanitizer harness targeting upb_MiniTable_Build() + upb_Decode().

Root cause:
upb_MiniTable_Build() produces a MiniTable whose enum sub-tables are not yet linked -- linking is a separate step via upb_MiniTable_SetSubEnum() / upb_MiniTable_Link(). A mini descriptor declaring a closed-enum field therefore yields sub->subenum == NULL for that field.

upb_Decode() does not verify this precondition. At upb/wire/decode.c:940-941 the sub-enum table pointer is obtained and passed to upb_MiniTableEnum_CheckValue(), which dereferences it unconditionally. The two observed crash addresses (0x0 and 0x8) correspond to the two branches inside CheckValue -- same underlying bug.

Crash input (hex): 24 34 08 34 00
